reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: Section 12.3 affirmatively disclaims any exclusivity, non-compete, field or territory restriction on Customer.
The only competition restraint (12.4) binds Vendor, which the rule expressly permits and which benefits us.
No redline or comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged and the deterministic check passes.
Rationale accurately characterizes 13.4 licence limits as ordinary misuse/reverse-engineering restrictions rather than field-of-use competitive restraints.
